# Pinterest Korea

> > Pinterest Korea is the Korean localized version of Pinterest, featuring curated visual discovery content including fashion trends, art tutorials, DIY crafts, digital design resources, and lifestyle inspiration across Korean, Russian, and Japanese language communities.

This site serves as Pinterest's Korean portal, offering daily trending content, idea exploration across categories like fashion and home decor, and extensive user-generated boards. It includes significant communities around digital art tutorials (Procreate), game fanart (Limbus Company, Library of Ruina), historical fashion, and mobile UI/UX design patterns.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest Korea
- Art Tutorials
- Digital Art & Illustration
- Mobile UI/UX Design
- Fashion Trends & Aesthetics
- DIY Crafts & Handmade
- Procreate Techniques
- Game Design & Pixel Art
- Japanese Language Learning (Hiragana, Katakana, Kanji)
- Historical Fashion (Renaissance, Elizabethan)
- Bullet Journaling & Planning
- Watercolor Techniques
- Drawing Guides for Beginners
- Instagram Content Curation
- Limbus Company & Library of Ruina Fanart

## Core Discovery & Trending

- [Explore the best of Pinterest](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas): Main discovery hub browsing ideas by category (food, DIY, fashion, decor)
- [Today's Top Trends on Pinterest](https://kr.pinterest.com/today): Daily curated trends featuring fashion, beauty, travel, and seasonal picks
- [Pinterest Official Profile](https://kr.pinterest.com/pinterest): Official Pinterest profile with 6.3M followers and curated boards
- [Pinterest Korea Profile](https://kr.pinterest.com/pinterestkorea): Official Pinterest Korea profile with curated Korean content boards
- [Pinterest Login](https://kr.pinterest.com/wid_1): Login page for accessing private user profiles and content

## Art & Design Tutorials

- [Procreate Brush Tutorials & Guides](https://kr.pinterest.com/procreate0126/procreate-brush-tutorials-guides): 540 Procreate brush tutorials from beginner to advanced techniques

- [Watercolour Boat Tutorial](https://kr.pinterest.com/pin/1140818149371300380): Step-by-step watercolor boat painting video tutorial by Louise De Masi
- [25 Flower Line Drawing Ideas](https://kr.pinterest.com/pin/61009769947562068): 25 flower line drawing tutorials from beginner to advanced levels
- [Drawing Techniques & Tutorials](https://kr.pinterest.com/oororo/techniques-tutorials-guides-etc): User board: 160 drawing techniques and digital painting tutorials
- [How to Draw a Rose Tutorial](https://kr.pinterest.com/pin/24136547999917070): 6-step rose drawing tutorial for kids and beginners
- [Art Techniques & Tips](https://kr.pinterest.com/007brokentreasu/tips): User board: Art tutorials covering painting and drawing techniques
